resources.string: Sabor is a digital cookbook designed ideally for home chefs and food enthusiasts by digitizing their own handwritten recipes and organizing their other online recipes. Sabor focuses on a high–aesthetic, “cookbook-style” reading experience. The target audience for Sabor is hobbyist cooks and foodies (ages 25-50) who value organization and visual inspiration but can also be used by anyone with a smart mobile device that can install the app.
